column1: # Benchmark routes for scripts/bench.py: name, DM_KEYS, measuring window start and length (s), description.
# From a new save (first boot), console mode. The presses are frame steps (applied at the game's own input reads), so the route holds at any frame rate; the windows are seconds
# from host start of the wave-3 Mac run with compute on (chain d1a62107da8c, 16-40 fps, run/MacPlay/r11.log): title "Press L + R to start" from about frame 2400 (L+R at 2500, 71 s),
# then A every 200 frames from 2700: Single Player, Grand Prix, Mario, Standard Kart, Mushroom Cup, "Start Grand Prix?" OK; the Mushroom Cup movie (KinokoOp.webm) from about
# frame 4140, the race (Mario Bros. Circuit) from about frame 5800, A held for acceleration from frame 6000 (199 s). The game note's "Route on the Mac" has the screenshots of each step

column5: Grand Prix, Mushroom Cup, race 1 (Mario Bros. Circuit) with A held from frame 6000
